best_practice_sources.name: PostgreSQL 18 row security policies
best_practice_sources.takeaway: RLS must be enabled to restrict normal row access; absent policies default-deny; table owners normally bypass RLS unless FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY is used.

best_practice_sources.name: PostgreSQL 18 continuous archiving and PITR
best_practice_sources.takeaway: PITR relies on base backups plus archived WAL replay and should be set up and tested before the first base backup; this slice models metadata requirements only, not live WAL archival.

best_practice_sources.name: Citus 13.0.1 choosing a distribution column
best_practice_sources.takeaway: Citus multi-tenant guidance recommends a common tenant_id distribution column, tenant-filtered queries, and colocated tenant rows; the guardrail requires tenant_id distribution and a colocated table ref for Citus.

best_practice_sources.name: PostgreSQL 18 CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY
best_practice_sources.takeaway: Online schema work has operational caveats; concurrent index builds cannot run inside a transaction block and can leave invalid indexes on failure, so this slice requires explicit forward/backward migration refs and synthetic corpus/audit evidence but does not implement a migration executor.
